Hello! I'm Erik De Luca, a freelance biostatistician and actuary.
I specialize in extracting strategic insights from complex data, providing clients with deep statistical modeling and comprehensive analytical reports.
But I don't stop at the analysis. With a strong passion for IT, I love automating workflows into robust data pipelines, reducing human error and improving delivery speed.
Using tools like Python, R, SQL, and Docker, I deploy scalable architectures both on-premise and in the cloud.
By integrating strict software engineering practices, such as Git versioning and automated testing, I ensure every analytical solution is secure and highly reliable.
Welcome to my portfolio!
